items.q: I understand, young lady, that you also are a friend of mine

된 된 My demoiselle Daniel Roth. He sits at Josh Gano from the Novel of León. He says, hello, my friend. How are you? I understand, young lady, that you also are a friend of mine, so I'll dress you in my Creole tongue. I hope that you are fine and well and continue to enjoy all the best that's in life. I've got your husband here, and I'm giving a few pointers on the trumpet. And if you're the nice person that he is, then I will say that you're all really and truly a nice couple. He's a fine and swell guy, and I…

Now, this tape will consist of mostly conversation. George is just going to get his scrapbook. A book where he put all the photographs and written down things in, you know. And he's going to tell me about all of that. Oh!
